hero.subtitle: Living documents, tracked reviews, and operational cadence in one auditable platform. Pick a framework or bring your own. AI helps with the work. Humans stay in control.

why.heading: Why another management system?
why.p1: Because the ones we have are complex, opaque, and treated as a compliance exercise — relevant for the audit, irrelevant the day after. And the stakes keep rising: as AI adoption accelerates and threat surfaces widen, a management system that doesn't stay alive is worse than useless.
why.p2: It doesn't have to work this way. Security done right starts at the root — genuinely understanding and managing your risks, not papering over them. Built AI-first, with real discipline in how it's designed and used, a management system should be a living part of how you operate, not a burden bolted on top.
why.p3: That's why it's open source — built for organizations of every size, and finally a credible option for smaller ones, who've never had a management system that's simple, stays current, and doesn't fight them. We built this to change that.

pillars.documents_desc: Policies live in git as markdown. Every edit is a commit. Every version recoverable. Documents drive your ISMS, not sit in a folder.
pillars.reviews_desc: Round-based review with inline comments. Approve, request changes, or propose a revision. Every decision is an immutable record with a SHA-256 hash.
pillars.tasks_desc: Annual plan distributes reviews, audits, and risk assessments across the calendar. Dashboard shows what needs attention this month. Your ISMS never goes stale.

how.heading: Five minutes, not five meetings
how.subtitle: From event to updated policy to approved document. The platform handles the busywork.
how.step1_desc: An incident, a new supplier, a regulation change, an audit finding. Any event that affects your security posture.
how.step2_desc: Log it in the right register. AI can suggest risk updates, policy changes, and corrective actions. You review each suggestion.
how.step3_desc: Policy changes land on a review branch with full diff. No mystery edits. Five documents in five minutes.
how.step4_desc: Reviewers get notified. Approve or request changes. After edits, resubmit as a new round. Each round shows only what changed since last feedback.
how.step5_desc: Merge to main. Version incremented. Decision record created. Evidence stored. Done.

features.heading: Built different
features.subtitle: Not a document editor with compliance plugins. A purpose-built management system where everything connects.
features.git_desc: Policies are markdown files in a git repo. Every change is a commit with full diff. Branch for review, merge to publish. No proprietary formats, no lock-in.
features.review_desc: Send a document for review. Reviewers approve, request changes, or propose a revision with inline comments. Resubmit as a new round — reviewers see only what changed.
features.registers_desc: Risks link to assets and controls. Incidents create corrective actions. Legal requirements link to policies. Change one thing, see the ripple everywhere.
features.ai_desc: AI agents draft policies, assess risks, and propose register updates through the same review workflow. 22-tool MCP server. Full agent identity and audit trail. Not autopilot — a capable assistant.
features.cadence_desc: Dashboard shows what needs attention this month. Distribute reviews, audits, and risk assessments across the year. Tasks track execution. Your ISMS stays alive.
features.audit_desc: Every review approval and document publish creates an immutable decision record with SHA-256 content hash. Timestamped, attributable, cryptographically verifiable.

frameworks.heading: Any framework. Your templates.
frameworks.subtitle: 11 built-in frameworks. Or bring your own templates — a folder of markdown files is all it takes. Run multiple standards on the same platform.

deploy.cloud_desc: Sign up, pick your framework, start working. We handle infrastructure, backups, and updates. Multi-tenant with row-level data isolation.
deploy.selfhost_desc: One Go binary. PostgreSQL and a data directory. Deploy anywhere — your infrastructure, your data. Apache 2.0, no artificial limits, no open-core tricks.

cta.heading: Your auditor will thank you
cta.subtitle: Full version history. Immutable approval records. Cryptographically verifiable decisions. Complete audit trail from day one.
